icons.name: defense
icons.prompt: Generate a production-ready 2D game skill icon for DEFENSE for a Valheim mod. The supplied image is a comparison: TOP ROW is genuine Valheim vanilla reference. BOTTOM ROW is the overdecorated old mod art which must be replaced: do NOT emulate the bottom row. Match top-row restraint and low-resolution hand-painted chunky faceted game rendering, but clean up silhouette and material readability slightly. Subject: one simple battered round wooden Viking shield, faded ochre-red painted wedge segments and weathered bare pale wood segments, a small dark iron central boss and narrow iron rim. A modest plain iron nasal helmet sits slightly behind upper-left, no horns, no decoration; shield occupies most of icon. Only these two simple objects. Slight three-quarter view, muted earthy palette, broad painted matte facets, gentle upper-left light, crisp readable chunky shapes, no photorealism, no realistic scratches or fine grunge, no shiny glossy metal, no filigree, no border, no badge, no wreath, no floor or background shadow, no lettering, no labels. Read clearly when reduced to 32 and 64 pixels. Use genuinely transparent background with clean alpha outside silhouette, NOT a checkerboard or solid backdrop. Square 1024x1024 canvas, subject centered with about 12% transparent margins all sides. Standalone icon only.

The attached reference sheet shows the nine icons already in the set (Defense, Sailing, Foraging, Husbandry, Cooking, Farming, Fishing, Woodcutting, Pickaxes; shown on a dark backdrop only for viewing): match their chunky hand-painted faceted surfaces, restrained earthy palette, matte rough materials, rendering scale and simple upper-left lighting exactly, so the new icon sits in the set seamlessly. Same level of simplification or simpler: designed for 32/64px display, clear strong silhouette, no tiny fussy details. Standalone subject, no UI frame, no medallion, no gold wreath, no ornate trim, no text, no labels, no floor, no cast shadow on background. Genuinely transparent background outside the silhouette, not a checkerboard and not solid black. Square canvas with about 12% transparent margins, subject centered. No glossy realism, no photorealistic textures. DODGE: one worn brown leather boot sliding sideways out of the way, a short curved spray of grey dust and small pebbles under it, while one dull-gray iron-tipped arrow flies past just above it from the upper-left. Only the boot, the dust and the arrow, no legs, no ground plane, no motion lines, no gold.
icons.reference: style_reference.png (the nine icons above, 3x3 on a dark backdrop), attached to every prompt
